items.title: Disney and Adobe are building generative AI tools together
items.excerpt: Disney named Adobe its official AI innovation partner in a multiyear deal: custom Firefly Foundry models trained on Disney content, with early access for parks, cruise line, studios and ESPN graphics.

items.title: Disney's AI deal with Adobe is raising eyebrows
items.excerpt: Creative-community angle on the Disney x Adobe Firefly alliance and what private, brand-safe Firefly models mean for Photoshop's maker and working artists. (Same story as The Verge item; alternate source.)

items.title: Instagram's Effect Builder makes new filters from AI prompts
items.excerpt: Instagram's new Effect Builder lets users generate custom Stories AR filters/effects from a text prompt, putting generative effect design in the hands of creators without Spark-style tooling.

items.title: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
items.excerpt: Anthropic had Claude design three devices (speakerphone, voice-assistant hub, handheld virtual pet): specs, component selection, four-layer PCB routing, firmware and CAD-modeled 3D-printed enclosures; the prototypes worked without circuitry fixes.

items.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items.excerpt: New Anthropic models; design hooks: Fable 5.2 scores 83.5 on BenchCAD 2.1 (vs 65.3 for Opus 5.5) and a Unity tester reports better from-scratch 3D scenes and rebuilding experiences from visual references. Overlaps with the electronics-design item.

items.title: Automattic debuts a platform to deploy vibe-coding apps amid a changing internet
items.excerpt: WordPress parent Automattic launched Spacefast, a platform for building and deploying vibe-coded apps, positioning against Lovable-style prompt-to-app builders.

items.title: Developers can now build with Google Maps Platform in AI Studio
items.excerpt: Google AI Studio's prompt-to-app builder now integrates Google Maps Platform, so vibe-coded apps can include interactive maps and location features generated from a description.

items.title: Higgsfield Miracle promises real-time AI video editing, turning any clip into editable layers
items.excerpt: Higgsfield unveiled Miracle (private beta/waitlist): edit a clip while it plays by describing a change, modifying individual objects, lighting and textures as layers without regenerating the footage. Off-list outlet; official page higgsfield.ai/miracle has no date. Check movies-section dup.

items.title: Speed up image generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
items.excerpt: NVIDIA details optimizations for Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 Image Klein on Blackwell, cutting diffusion latency for design tools, image editors and visual production (image-to-image up to ~4.45x faster). Near the window edge.

items.title: Chaos releases Corona 16 for 3ds Max and Cinema 4D
items.excerpt: Corona 16 adds relighting of imported 3D Gaussian Splats, native parallax interiors and Chaos's new AI Assistant for context-aware support and Cosmos asset recommendations. (Time from Google News; image path dated 261109.)

items.title: Chaos releases V-Ray 7.5 for 3ds Max with new AI features
items.excerpt: V-Ray 7.5 for 3ds Max adds an integrated AI Assistant that even critiques renders out of 10 for artistic merit, plus other AI and non-AI features. Deprioritized: Chaos V-Ray AI ran 11-07. (Time from Google News; image path dated 261108.)

items.title: AI companies are offering architects six figures for CAD files; have you been approached?
items.excerpt: AI firms are reportedly offering architecture practices six-figure sums for their CAD/BIM archives as training data, raising IP and client-confidentiality questions for design firms. Off-list outlet (no on-list CAD-data coverage).

items.title: This prototype camera is fighting the good fight against AI photography
items.excerpt: The Caim-1 prototype camera embeds cryptographic proof into every photo to counter AI fakes, a hardware take on content provenance for photographers and image editors.

items.title: Apple starts offering $50 extended usage packs for AI features in Creator Studio
items.excerpt: Apple now sells $49.99 Intelligence Usage Packs to extend AI features in its Creator Studio pro apps (e.g. Logic Pro's AI assistant) past monthly limits, a metered-AI cost shift for creative pros. Check music-section dup.

items.title: Practice makes precise: at CoRL, NVIDIA and partners reveal how robots rehearse delicate work in simulation
items.excerpt: At CoRL NVIDIA introduced GR00T 2, Isaac Lab 3.0 and new open benchmarks for simulation-trained robot dexterity, the physical-AI toolchain behind robot and product design.

items.title: Five pairs of hands: what the typesetters can teach designers about AI
items.excerpt: A conversation with Christian Crumlish comparing the collapse of the typesetting chain to AI merging design roles today, and which work designers should keep. Opinion piece; UXC capped this run.

items.title: An anti-AI indie game about keeping hand-drawn fish has become a surprise viral hit
items.excerpt: A deliberately hand-drawn, anti-AI indie game went viral, a signal of creative-audience backlash and demand for visibly human craft. Weak AI substance; check games-section dup.
